list.name: agent
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT agent FROM token_usage ORDER BY agent

list.name: telegram_user_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT chat_id::text FROM token_usage ORDER BY chat_id::text

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, agent, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens FROM token_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND agent IN ($agent) AND chat_id::text IN ($telegram_user_id) GROUP BY 1, agent ORDER BY 1

SELECT chat_id AS telegram_user_id, agent, sum(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, count(*) AS llamadas, round(avg(latency_ms)) AS latencia_media_ms FROM token_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND agent IN ($agent) AND chat_id::text IN ($telegram_user_id) GROUP BY chat_id, agent ORDER BY total_tokens DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Latencia media del LLM por agente (ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, agent, avg(latency_ms) AS latencia_ms FROM token_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND agent IN ($agent) AND chat_id::text IN ($telegram_user_id) GROUP BY 1, agent ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, status, count(*) AS llamadas FROM token_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND agent IN ($agent) AND chat_id::text IN ($telegram_user_id) GROUP BY 1, status ORDER BY 1
